import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' and 'time' columns to datetime
coffee_sales['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'] + ' ' + coffee_sales['time'])

# Create a new column for total sales by age group
sales_by_age_group = coffee_sales.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Create a bar plot for total sales by customer age group
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='customer_age_group', y='total', data=sales_by_age_group, palette='viridis')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Total Coffee Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(axis='y')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' and 'time' columns to datetime
coffee_sales['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'] + ' ' + coffee_sales['time'])

# Create a new column for total sales by age group
sales_by_age_group = coffee_sales.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Create a bar plot for total sales by customer age group
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='customer_age_group', y='total', data=sales_by_age_group, palette='viridis')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Total Coffee Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(axis='y')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
